# Lane 2.46: staff-only numbers for signed-in staff (note of 2026-11-22)

Branch `lane/2.46-staff-numbers`, merged with `build/stage-1` on 2026-11-22 (commit fde9d883). Not pushed: the lead pushes.

## What the lane holds

- Core: `signedInViewer` (`packages/core/src/modules/people/rules/viewer.ts`) and `readTeamsBeyondPublic` (standings), each with its test; an isolation case in `packages/database/src/isolation/public-reads-cases.test-helper.ts`.
- One signed-in read, `GET /api/v1/leagues/{leagueId}/staff-numbers` (`apps/web/src/server/staff-numbers-endpoint.ts`): league from the address, account from the session, `private, no-store`, one answer `{"more":null}` for everyone not allowed. Player lines keyed by place (`player-N`, `away-player-N`), never a person's id (D-M4).
- The statistics, team and game pages split into a view of words (`*-view.ts`) and a drawing (`*-drawn.tsx`); the page draws the public's, the device swaps in the staff view (`features/staff-numbers`). Cached page and live messages unchanged.
- Made-up data: an Owls coach in the stand-in (id 0xae, grant 15), a coach for two Lakeside teams in the seed.
- Record 085, pending T-287 (Agreed (delegated)), pending S-80 (Decided for you), P7 line under S-22, T4 §7 and T5 §4 updated.
- Checks entered: `scripts/check-web-shell.mjs` `checkStaffNumbers` (seven kinds of person), the answer route in `tests/browser/harmful-text-test.mjs` (asked with the attack in its questions). No page route and no browser helper added.

## The merge (six conflicts)

Stand-in cast and grants (2.157's long-address scheduler kept 0xad and grant 14; the Owls' coach moved), site messages (both kept), and the statistics, team and game pages: the lane's view/drawn split kept, the build's new words moved into it (a statistic recorded in fewer games, 2.199; the team-totals note, 2.196; a box score's "nothing recorded" panel and table notes). The lane's database test now gives its ports `botCheck`. No new database port, so the event-handlers list is unchanged.

## Proved (2026-11-22, after the merge)

- `npm run check`, `npm run typecheck`: pass. Prettier on changed files: pass.
- `npx vitest run` on `apps/web/src/server`, the stats, team, live-game and staff-numbers features, core people and standings, database seed, `packages/site`: 142 files, 1670 tests pass. Database isolation and public reads: 341 pass.
- `npm run test:web`: 204 checks pass. `node --test tests/web-browser-chain.test.mjs`: 9 pass. `node --test tests/pending-decisions.test.mjs`: 11 pass.
- `node tests/browser/staff-numbers-test.mjs` (with build, then `--no-build`): 164 checks pass. Harmful-text browser test `--no-build`: 1807 checks pass. Pictures looked at: game and team page at 390 as the Otters' coach (note, players, team-totals note in place).

## Not verified

The whole gate (`npm run verify`, all browser tests) was not run here. No real PostgreSQL or Supabase. GitHub has not checked this branch since the merge.

## LEFT

Nothing: ready for review.

## Where to look hardest

`staff-numbers-endpoint.ts` (one answer for all not allowed; nothing logged), `viewer.ts` (who counts as staff, S-80), and whether the build's team-totals note (2.196, `build-team.ts`) should be said to the public on a team whose players are hidden: it hints that player numbers exist.

## Fix round (after review: no High, one Medium)

- Proof: `database-staff-numbers.test.ts` now hides the Herons too (they played the Otters, each with a player line). Each coach gets their own players and not one of the other's on the statistics page, their own team page and the game (box score and plays), and nothing on the other's page; the coach of the other seed league's own "Otters" gets nothing. No leak found.
- `staff-numbers-endpoint.test.ts`: the `not.toMatch(bearsPlayer)` check could not bite (stand-in Bears have no line; giving them one changes pinned answers across the stand-in's tests), so it is removed and the proof points to the database test.
- Team and statistics pages set up the staff request only when totals are shown (`TeamStatsPart`, `StatsTablesPart`): a hidden team with nothing recorded carries no trace of it (unit tests in `team-pages.test.ts`, `stats-pages.test.ts`). Polish line added for the silent `.catch` at `staff-numbers-endpoint.ts:154`.
